points.K4: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好
points.K6: 安全是双向的，员工也有责任
points.K7: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色
points.K9: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查

shots.scene: 欣欣站在明亮的实验室里，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a bright busy lab and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：实验室安全，人人有责。
overlay: 实验室安全：雇主的工作场所安全指南

shots.scene: 一边是公司大楼图标，一边是员工图标，中间双向箭头
shots.prompt_en: A company building icon on one side and a group of worker pictograms on the other, joined by a two-way arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 雇主有雇主的责任，员工有员工的。

shots.scene: 小研和王老师在玻璃温室旁交谈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the safety administrator, both in lab coats, talk beside a glass greenhouse.
shots.narration: 大家聊起：安全到底是谁的事？

shots.scene: 明亮实验室里多人工作，王老师在巡视
shots.prompt_en: Several people work in a bright lab while the safety administrator walks around observing.
shots.narration: 别忘了，雇主在这里也有责任。

shots.section_title: 针对本实验室制定应急预案
shots.scene: 王老师对着空白应急预案文件，旁边浮现本实验室的危害图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator works on a blank emergency plan binder, with this lab's hazard pictograms floating beside it.
shots.narration: 营造安全环境，针对具体危害定预案。
overlay: 针对本实验室制定应急预案

shots.section_title: 针对本实验室制定应急预案
shots.scene: 火灾、溢洒、受伤图标连到预案本
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a fire, a spill and an injury, each linked by a line to a blank plan binder. No people.
shots.narration: 预案要全面。

shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给员工上课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of lab staff in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 定期培训员工，

shots.scene: 大家沿疏散箭头有序走出实验室
shots.prompt_en: Lab staff walk out in an orderly line along an evacuation arrow during a drill.
shots.narration: 组织演练，让人人都知道该做什么。

shots.section_title: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好
shots.scene: 灭火器、洗眼器、溢洒处理箱三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a fire extinguisher, an eyewash station and a spill kit box. No people.
shots.narration: 维护安全设备：灭火器、洗眼器、溢洒包，
overlay: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好

shots.section_title: 安全设备随手可取、状态完好
shots.scene: 老李检查灭火器压力表，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks the pressure gauge of a fire extinguisher, and a green check appears.
shots.narration: 样样随手可取，状态完好。

shots.scene: 旧规程本换成新规程本，旁边新危害图标和法规本
shots.prompt_en: An old blank procedure binder is swapped for a new one, next to a new hazard icon and an updated regulation booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 跟上新危害和新法规，审查更新规程。

shots.section_title: 安全是双向的，员工也有责任
shots.scene: 小研、阿杰、老周围在实验台前讨论
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the older man gather around a lab bench in discussion.
shots.narration: 安全不是单行道，
overlay: 安全是双向的，员工也有责任

shots.section_title: 安全是双向的，员工也有责任
shots.scene: 双向箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A large two-way arrow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 员工也有自己的责任。

shots.section_title: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色
shots.scene: 阿杰戴好手套，调整袖口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student pulls on gloves and adjusts the cuffs.
shots.narration: 熟悉应急程序：
overlay: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色

shots.section_title: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色
shots.scene: 走廊里的红色灭火器和安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: A red fire extinguisher in a corridor and an emergency exit sign above a door. No people.
shots.narration: 知道出口和灭火器在哪，

shots.section_title: 熟悉应急程序和自己的角色
shots.scene: 阿杰胸前别着空白角色牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears a blank role badge on his chest.
shots.narration: 明白自己在应急中的角色。

shots.scene: 小研和老李拿平板在设备间巡看
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the facility engineer walk through an equipment room holding tablets.
shots.narration: 认真对待培训，这不是做样子。

shots.scene: 穿蓝色防护服戴面屏的阿杰低头工作，演练图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in a blue protective gown and face shield works with his head down, beside a drill evacuation icon.
shots.narration: 积极参加演练，把学到的记在心里。

shots.section_title: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查
shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜和口罩，整理发帽
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in safety goggles and a respirator mask adjusts her hair cap.
shots.narration: 维护个人防护装备：
overlay: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查

shots.section_title: 防护用品勤清洁、勤检查
shots.scene: 擦拭护目镜、对光检查手套
shots.prompt_en: Hands wipe a pair of goggles clean and hold a glove up to the light to inspect it. No people.
shots.narration: 保持清洁，定期检查，用前确认完好。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜口罩，查看试剂瓶标签
shots.prompt_en: The young male student in goggles, mask and hair cap examines the blank label of a reagent bottle and frowns.
shots.narration: 一发现隐患，就马上报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports the problem bottle to the older man.
shots.narration: 别等出了事再说，要主动。

shots.scene: 小研戴护目镜，抬头环顾四周
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in safety goggles looks up and around the lab attentively.
shots.narration: 保持警觉，对周围情况心中有数，

shots.scene: 两名穿防护服的人在实验台并肩操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student in protective coats work side by side at a bench.
shots.narration: 护好自己，也护好同事。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现预案、培训、设备、规程图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a plan binder, a classroom, an extinguisher and a procedure book.
shots.narration: 雇主：预案、培训、设备、规程。

shots.scene: 出口、护目镜、电话、眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exit sign, safety goggles, a telephone and an open eye. No people.
shots.narration: 员工：懂程序、护装备、报隐患、要警觉。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the lab doorway.
shots.narration: 安全靠大家，下次见！
